fields.title: Select a column
fields.description: Select the column whose values are split.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove input column
fields.description: When checked, the selected input column will not be part of the output table.

fields.title: Enter a delimiter
fields.description: Specify the delimiter in the value, that splits each part.

fields.title: Use \ as escape character
fields.description: If enabled, the backslash (\) can be used to escape characters, such as \t for tabs. You can use the full escape capabilities of Java.

fields.title: Enter a quotation character
fields.description: Specify the quotation character if the different parts in the value are quoted. (The character to escape quotes is always the backslash.) If no quotation character is needed leave it empty.

fields.title: Remove leading and trailing white space chars (trim)
fields.description: If checked, leading and trailing white spaces of each part (token) will be deleted.

fields.title: Output format
fields.description: Select how the split results should be output: as a list collection, as a set collection (duplicates removed), or as separate columns.

fields.title: Split input column name for output column names
fields.description: When outputting as new columns, check this option when the input column name can be split in the same manner as the column's content to obtain the names for the output columns.

fields.title: Size determination
fields.description: Choose whether to specify a fixed number of output columns or to automatically determine the size.

choices.label: Guess size and column types (requires additional data table scan)

fields.title: Number of columns
fields.description: Specify the number of columns to append. All created columns will be of type String.

fields.title: Scan limit (number of lines to guess on)
fields.description: Maximum number of rows to scan for guessing the number of output columns.

fields.title: Maximum rows to scan
fields.description: Maximum number of rows to scan for guessing the number of output columns and their types.

fields.title: Create empty string cells
fields.description: If checked, empty string cells are created for missing or short input cells instead of missing value cells.
